encounter: P8 play_order 86 TRAINER_TED (Trick House puzzle 2, Route 110), cap window 36
availability_audit: Chronology anchor: every battle in this block sits at or after the player's first arrival in Mauville City (Dynamo Badge / Wattson cleared), on Route 110 (Trick House puzzle 2), Rusturf Tunnel, or Routes 111/112/113. Every member below is drawn from work/reference-pools/pool-36.json with gate <= 36 and a source_detail map that a player standing on those maps has already passed: Route 102/103/104, Petalburg Woods, Rusturf Tunnel, Granite Cave, Seaspray Cave, Altering Cave, Route 110/116/117, New Mauville and the Mauville Game Corner. Route 118 sources are deliberately excluded because Route 118 lies east of Mauville past this block's maps. No legendary, mythical, Ultra Beast or Paradox species is used. Evolution items (Shiny Stone, Linking Cord) come from the Slateport/Mauville evolution stock already reached; the Gyaradosite stone window is 20 and the Mega Ring was earned from Steven after Brawly, both well before this block. Excadrill added for this battle from Drilbur on Rusturf Tunnel land (pool gate 20 / evolution gate 36); Rusturf Tunnel is passed long before Route 110 Trick House.
plan: Ted is Fairy/Steel/Dark: Choice Scarf Gardevoir, Prankster Klefki, Fur Coat Alolan Persian and Assault Vest Copperajah. Alakazam is swapped out because three of the four carry Dark damage (two Foul Plays plus Persian STAB) and Psychic is dead weight. Excadrill replaces it: Ground is 2x into Klefki and Copperajah, Steel typing resists Gardevoir and Klefki Fairy STAB, and Mold Breaker is insurance. Incineroar and Rillaboom lead for Fire and Ground pressure on the two Steels.
